title: Los Angeles Duo MUNNYCAT shares a stunning single titled "Giddy Up"
htmlContent:
Los Angeles-based songwriting and production Duo MUNNYCAT, which consists of K808 & Khaledzou (who got married to each other), have returned with their stunning new single titled "Giddy Up." The talented Duo joined forces to blur the lines between escape room pop and golden-age hip-hop.

MUNNYCAT's "Giddy Up" is an excellent and well-produced track with a genre-blending sound with great appeal. MUNNYCAT means business when showcasing the kind of loyalty they have in their craft. The creativity in the music is second to none and helps the vision to life as you find something new and fun to admire in their music.
